newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Goulds Pumps started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goulds Pumps started.

text.p: -- Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc said Friday it initiated coverage of Goulds Pumps Inc with a rating of market performer.

-- Rauscher Pierce said market penetration potential exists for Goulds Pumps, notably in Europe. The company also warned that Goulds faces special challenges in fiscal 1997 with European and U.S. economies growing slowly.
-- Goulds Pumps makes pumps for industrial and water applications, with a specific presence in the chemical, pulp/paper and residential markets.
-- Its shares were unchanged Friday afternoon at 24-1/8.
